objectives.en: Define a relation as a subset of A × B
Find its domain, codomain and range

narration.en: "Is the square of" picks out a few pairs from all possible pairs of numbers. Picking pairs by a rule gives a relation.

body.en: A relation $R$ from $A$ to $B$ is a subset of $A \times B$. If $(a, b) \in R$, $b$ is the image of $a$. The domain is the set of first entries, the range is the set of second entries, and $B$ is the codomain. Range $\subset$ codomain.
body.kn: A ಯಿಂದ B ಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಎಂದರೆ A × B ಯ ಉಪಗಣ. ಮೊದಲ ಅಂಶಗಳು ಪ್ರದೇಶ, ಎರಡನೇ ಅಂಶಗಳು ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ, B ಸಹಪ್ರದೇಶ.

points.en: Shown by roster, set-builder form or an arrow diagram

narration.en: A relation from A to B is any subset of A cross B. Its first entries form the domain, its second entries form the range, and the whole of B is the codomain.
narration.kn: A ಯಿಂದ B ಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಎಂದರೆ A × B ಯ ಉಪಗಣ. ಮೊದಲ ಅಂಶಗಳು ಪ್ರದೇಶ, ಎರಡನೇ ಅಂಶಗಳು ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ, B ಸಹಪ್ರದೇಶ.

body.en: Number of relations from A to B = 2 raised to the number of pairs in A × B, that is 2^(pq). It includes the empty relation and A × B itself.
